findings.claim: The trusted classifier is materialized through caller-controlled Git interpretation, rather than executing the exact blob and tree at M. Reusing the original GIT_DIR preserves replace refs, local attributes and smudge filters; checkout-index applies them, and is_file follows symlinks. A valid full-class classifier can therefore become duong_nhanh and allow rc 0 without a switch read, while the product-file and live-master self-checks still pass. This does not require editing packet_loop.py.

python -B /tmp/wp1462-review-r1/probes.py, rc 0: canonical classifier still prints che_do=day_du while filtered materialization returns duong_nhanh. A classifier stored as a symlink executes an external /tmp file; changing that file changes the result with identical M/H. Artifacts: probes.json and probes.py.

Violates frozen spec B-4 and section 5: exact master blob, exact temporary tree, no caller-controlled classification. Scanned materialization, Git object interpretation and symlink resolution as one cause class.

findings.claim: The total HTTP deadline is checked only before read1. If a read begun within budget returns EOF after the deadline, the loop breaks and returns a successful response without another check. Each read also retains the original socket timeout instead of the remaining total budget. An over-budget response can therefore authorize a reduction, contrary to section 6b.
evidence: python -B /tmp/wp1462-review-r1/deadline15.py, rc 0: unchanged production han=15, two reads of 7.6 seconds each, elapsed 15.200912 seconds; real _rest_get and _b4_cong_tac return khop and HIEU_LUC. Exactly one GET with timeout=15 was observed. Artifact: deadline15.json.

probes.py healthy control with budget 2 returns 200 in about 1.30 seconds; the identical response with budget 1 is also accepted after about 1.30 seconds. These use a deterministic urllib response seam because the sandbox denies socket creation; they are not claimed as real-network measurements.

suggested_fix.how: Enforce the remaining wall-clock budget across opening and every read, including EOF and the byte-limit exit; reject completion after the deadline. Keep the per-socket bound, one-request behavior and proxy support. Do not merely extend the permitted duration in the test.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Add delayed-EOF and late-final-chunk cases with valid switch JSON, plus within-budget controls. Past-deadline completion must raise _B4Loi and never emit khop/HIEU_LUC. A mutant removing the completion check must be killed by the target ChotB4 case. Run real loopback variants on a capable environment.
suggested_fix.what_the_fix_may_spawn: Remaining-budget changes can break HTTPError response handling, proxies, empty bodies and boundary-time behavior; avoid timing-flaky assertions and preserve response cleanup.

findings.claim: The source tests do not yet satisfy the spec requirement for two-sided cases and a dedicated mutant for every new contract guard. Independent non-equivalent mutations survive the executable B4 suite: K2b moved before K7, updated_at promoted into a permission predicate, fixed commit dates removed, treating only the literal 1 as a nonempty ban, and comparing only seven OID characters. The code implements these five rules correctly today, but its tests do not lock them. This is the historical B4-S05 cause class, not a new class or a reset of its five specification-review recurrences.

python -B /tmp/wp1462-review-r1/locking_witnesses.py, rc 0: three new independent witness cases pass on H and each kills its corresponding mutation through that case's own ChotB4. Order witness has K7 and K2b both red; metadata witness uses a valid older updated_at; date witness inspects the synthetic commit's author/committer epoch. Artifacts: own-mutant-*.json and locking_witnesses.json.

The 11 excluded transport cases invoke _rest_get directly, outside these five changed boundaries. Existing diagnostic-line kills for missing steps, a non-object step and a non-object JSON root are valid own-ChotB4 kills and are not part of this finding.

findings.claim: The static prefilter misses ten registered cases that enter _c1106 through indirect CASES lookups. Consequently the reported 147/147 is a complete count only of the selected ordinary/completed calls, not of the spec's entire _c1106 fixture population. The independent census finds 157 entering cases. Nine omitted cases intentionally fail during setup/import/dispatch; r1187_overflow_crash_credit actually launches an intentionally modified kiem-merge script. All ten pass independently on both base and H, so this is an acceptance-measurement completeness defect, not a demonstrated behavior regression in those cases.

One unrelated milestone probe initially failed because the scratch base lacked origin/master; after fixing that scratch ref, its isolated rerun passes and has no _c1106 entry.

python -B /tmp/wp1462-review-r1/census_omitted.py, rc0: preserved original _c1106 and test fault injection; 20/20 omitted-case runs pass across base/head. Trace: setup cases stop before runner; import/dispatch cases enter the transition runner then produce expected CliSapDo; overflow case executes kiem-merge and returns rc1 on its intentional mutated script. Exact names and traces are in census_omitted.json.

The original do_b4.py ab still returns rc0 and reports 147. Its matcher does not follow dict(CASES) indirection, and do_ca records only completed calls after the runner returns. Spec acceptance 1 requires all cases through _c1106 and rejects a compared count smaller than the base census.

suggested_fix.how: Obtain the fixture population from an independently instrumented full-book run, or another demonstrably complete discovery method, and record entries and outcomes before invoking the runner. Preserve intentional fault/mutated-script semantics. Explicitly account for comparable calls and pre-CLI failures; do not silently drop the latter or relabel the 147 subset as every builder case. If a meta-case cannot meet the frozen comparison contract, report that limitation for an authorized scope decision.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Add discovery self-checks using a case reached through dict(CASES), a setup exception, a transition-runner exception and a nested modified-script run. The observed population/outcome accounting must include them; restoring the old prefilter or dropping exceptional outcomes must fail the dedicated measurement self-check. Reconcile the measured 157 entering cases with the 147 ordinary comparable cases and all ten special cases.
suggested_fix.what_the_fix_may_spawn: A broad call-graph scan can accidentally traverse every registry or run cases twice; instrumentation can suppress the intended injected failure or substitute the wrong product script. Keep exact case identities, preserve fault injection, and distinguish expected harness failures, infrastructure errors, skips and real A/B differences.
